# Rules and presets

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

aigate-lite 0.1.0: 66 rules. Actions: block | fix | warn | off (block and fix stop the commit). Override any of them in `.aigate/lite.toml` `[rules]`.

## Presets

`preset = "relaxed" | "balanced" | "strict"` in `.aigate/lite.toml` (default balanced). Effective config = built-in defaults, then the preset, then your own settings (yours always win). Only the settings a preset changes are listed; balanced changes nothing.

| setting | relaxed | balanced | strict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code.todo` | off | warn | warn |
| `deps.typosquat` | warn | warn | fix |
| `deps.undeclared` | warn | fix | fix |
| `deps.version_cooldown` | warn | fix | fix |
| `security.insecure_default` | warn | warn | fix |
| `security.weak_crypto` | warn | warn | fix |
| `security.xss` | warn | warn | fix |
| `size.*` | off | (each rule's default) | (each rule's default) |
| `suppress.coverage` | warn | fix | fix |
| `suppress.type` | warn | fix | fix |
| `tests.expected_changed` | warn | warn | fix |
| `tests.no_assertions` | warn | warn | fix |
| `[gate] offline` | warn | warn | block |
| `[limits] complexity` | 15 | 10 | 8 |
| `[limits] function_lines` | 100 | 60 | 50 |

## Rules

| rule | default | severity | what |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code.bare_except` | warn | low | Bare `except:` also catches KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit |
| `code.console_log` | warn | low | console.log left in source |
| `code.debug_leftover` | fix | medium | Debugger statement left in |
| `code.duplicate_block` | warn | low | Duplicated block of code |
| `code.mutable_default` | warn | medium | Mutable default argument |
| `code.placeholder` | fix | high | Placeholder or truncated code |
| `code.stub` | warn | low | Function has no implementation |
| `code.swallowed_exception` | fix | medium | Error silently swallowed |
| `code.syntax_error` | fix | high | File does not parse |
| `code.todo` | warn | low | New TODO/FIXME |
| `code.unused_import` | warn | low | Import is never used |
| `commands.failed` | fix | high | Configured command failed |
| `commands.untrusted` | warn | low | Configured commands not approved yet, so they did not run |
| `deps.deprecated` | warn | medium | Package or version is deprecated or yanked |
| `deps.hallucinated` | block | critical | Package does not exist on the registry |
| `deps.local_source` | warn | low | Dependency installed from a local path |
| `deps.new_package` | fix | high | Package was first published very recently |
| `deps.outdated` | warn | low | Pinned version is a major version behind |
| `deps.removed_stdlib` | fix | medium | Module was removed from the Python standard library |
| `deps.typosquat` | warn | high | Name is one or two edits away from a popular package |
| `deps.undeclared` | fix | medium | Import is not declared as a dependency |
| `deps.untrusted_source` | block | high | Dependency from git, a URL or a custom index |
| `deps.unverified` | warn | low | Package could not be checked (registry unreachable) |
| `deps.version_cooldown` | fix | medium | Version was published very recently |
| `deps.vulnerable` | fix | high | Pinned version has known vulnerabilities (OSV) |
| `gate.config_changed` | warn | medium | Gate or hook configuration changed |
| `gate.config_invalid` | warn | low | Problem in .aigate/lite.toml |
| `gate.error` | block | high | aigate-lite could not finish a check |
| `perf.call_in_loop` | warn | medium | Network or database call inside a loop (N+1) |
| `perf.exponential_recursion` | warn | medium | Recursion that branches without memoisation |
| `perf.nested_loops` | warn | medium | Deeply nested loops |
| `perf.quadratic_pattern` | warn | medium | Likely quadratic pattern inside a loop |
| `scope.forbidden_path` | block | high | Change to a forbidden path |
| `scope.out_of_scope` | fix | medium | File is outside the task scope you declared |
| `secrets.env_file` | block | critical | Env, key or credential file staged |
| `secrets.env_not_ignored` | warn | medium | A local .env file is not git-ignored |
| `secrets.generic` | fix | high | Credential-like value written into the code |
| `secrets.hardcoded` | block | critical | Provider credential or private key in the diff |
| `security.deserialization` | fix | high | Unsafe deserialization |
| `security.eval` | fix | high | Dynamic code execution |
| `security.insecure_default` | warn | medium | Insecure default (debug mode, wildcard CORS or hosts) |

| `security.verification_disabled` | fix | high | TLS or signature verification disabled |

| `security.xss` | warn | medium | Raw HTML injection |
| `size.complexity` | warn | medium | High cyclomatic complexity |
